model: Maternal thorax after Lu et al. 2001 (lumped graft onto Jongen 2016); appended after maternal_hr_randall2019.json
order: Entries continue the index order of model/core.c after MR_DS; do not reorder.

parameters.name: MT_FA
parameters.meaning: intrathoracic share of maternal arterial compliance
parameters.source_detail: fitted jointly with MV_KR, MV_KV to a 40 mmHg Valsalva (Fox, measured, Lu 2001 Table 13; MAP phase 1)
parameters.note: Lu/VS001 itself: Caop/(Caop+Caod+Csap) = 0.11. Thorax-only fit to the SBP phase-1 rise: 0.45

parameters.name: MT_FVAB
parameters.meaning: abdominal share of maternal venous compliance
parameters.source_detail: fitted jointly with MV_KR, MV_KV to a 40 mmHg Valsalva (Fox, measured, Lu 2001 Table 13; CO phase 2)
parameters.note: Lu 2001 has no abdomen; its stiff venous P-V curve plays this role. Thorax-only fit: 0.805

parameters.name: MT_KAB
parameters.meaning: abdominal pressure rise per thoracic pressure rise
parameters.source_detail: strain and pushing are held with the abdominal wall; intra-abdominal and intrathoracic pressures rise together

parameters.name: MT_CTH
parameters.source_detail: 1/K1 (vena cava) + Ctpap + Ctpad + Cpa + Cpc + Cpv

parameters.name: MT_VTH
parameters.meaning: intrathoracic venous + pulmonary blood volume at rest (moved from the venous pool)
parameters.source_detail: initial Vvc + Vpap + Vpad + Vpa + Vpc + Vpv
parameters.note: bookkeeping only; does not change dynamics

parameters.name: MT_DPF
parameters.meaning: resting pressure drop across MT_RVR, added back to the filling pressure

parameters.name: MT_RVR
parameters.meaning: venous return resistance into the thorax
parameters.source_detail: Rvc = KR (Vmax_vc/Vvc)^2 + Ro at the initial Vvc
